title: Phone connection: new messages to keep or change

steps.path: The strip at the top of a conversation while the phone is reconnecting
steps.headline: The reconnecting strip now says press Send again, and the Android app gets Use this phone only.
steps.changed: New words, and on Android a Use this phone only button.
steps.notice: Nothing sends by itself after a drop, so the words now match.
steps.risk: The button squeezes the title onto two lines.

steps.path: The strip at the top of a conversation when the computer is slow but still connected
steps.headline: A new strip says Waiting for your computer when it is slow to answer, and that what you send will still arrive.
steps.changed: This strip did not exist. It shows when the connection is up but your computer has not answered for a few seconds.
steps.notice: A slow computer no longer looks like a frozen app. The strip goes away by itself once the computer answers.
steps.risk: On a flaky connection it may flicker on and off. It has no button, so it only explains.

steps.path: The screen the Android app shows on launch before the conversation appears
steps.headline: The Android app now opens on Connecting to Home PC instead of briefly showing the phone's own conversations.
steps.changed: At launch the app goes back to the computer it was last using, and shows its name while it connects.
steps.notice: You land in your computer's conversations, not the phone's, so nothing is sent to the wrong place.
steps.risk: Nothing to tap while it connects.

steps.path: The same launch screen when the computer cannot be reached
steps.headline: If the computer is away, the launch screen says Can't reach Home PC, keeps trying, and offers Try now or Use this phone only.
steps.changed: The app used to give up and open on the phone by itself. Now it keeps trying and lets you choose.
steps.notice: It retries every few seconds, slowing to every 30. Use this phone only forgets the computer.
steps.risk: It can look stuck if you did not expect it.

steps.path: The sign-in page of the web version on a phone or tablet
steps.headline: A browser tab that was taken over by another tab now says so, with a Refresh button, above the password box.
steps.changed: A second tab of the same browser now closes the first tab's connection, and the first tab says why.
steps.notice: Refresh brings it back with no password typing.
steps.risk: Two tabs can no longer both work.

steps.path: A small message at the bottom of the screen
steps.headline: Two new pop-up messages: a message that did not reach your computer is back in the box, and a saved password was refused.
steps.changed: First: after a lost send, your words return to the message box. Second: Home PC did not accept the saved password, with where to fix it.
steps.notice: You see them for a few seconds after reopening. The second names the computer and points to Settings, Connect to Desktop.
steps.risk: They disappear on their own, so a missed one leaves your words in the box with no other trace.
